privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body:
## Who handles your enquiry

Ropulse is a brand developed and operated by Ebosoft Solutions, Pakistan. Contact support@ropulse.io about this notice, your enquiry or a privacy request.

## Information you provide

Our contact and demo forms collect your name, business name, business email address or phone number, country, branch count and permission to contact you about the enquiry. Please do not submit passwords, payment card details, customer records or other sensitive information.

## How we use your information

We use these details to respond, discuss your business requirements, arrange demonstrations and follow up on your request. Submitting an enquiry does not create an account, take a payment or subscribe you to marketing. If you provide an email address, it is used as the reply-to address on the notification sent to our team.

## Services and access

Vercel hosts this website and processes requests and technical information needed to operate it. Resend sends enquiry notifications to the Ebosoft Solutions team through its support mailbox and an additional team-controlled Gmail mailbox. Authorized team members can access enquiries in those mailboxes. Google and the support mailbox provider process the delivered messages under their respective service settings.

Cloudflare Turnstile checks for automated abuse before an enquiry can be sent. Turnstile processes verification tokens and browser, device and network information for security purposes. We verify the token on the server. These services may process information outside Pakistan. See [Cloudflare’s privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/), [Resend’s privacy policy](https://resend.com/legal/privacy-policy) and [Vercel’s privacy policy](https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy) for their processing information.

## Storage and retention

This website does not create a separate enquiry database. Enquiry details are sent by email; messages and delivery records may remain in the receiving mailboxes and service-provider systems. Retention depends on the handling of your enquiry, the relevant mailbox and provider settings, and any applicable recordkeeping obligations. This notice does not promise automatic deletion after a fixed period.

## Your choices

You may contact us directly by email instead of using the form. You can ask about your enquiry information, request a correction or deletion, or ask us to stop following up by emailing support@ropulse.io. We may need information to verify your request and will explain any limits on fulfilling it.

## Website security and tracking

We use encrypted HTTPS connections, form validation and abuse checks. Hosting and email providers may retain operational and security records. The website does not currently include advertising trackers, marketing analytics or automatic marketing subscriptions. This notice covers this public website and its enquiry forms; it does not describe every data flow inside the Ropulse POS application.

## Changes

We will update this page when the website’s enquiry processing changes. The review date above identifies this version.
